items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-07-01
items.q: I first began playing music at the 101 Ranch with Jimmy Palau.

ctx.x: 25-22nd Street, New Orleans, Louisiana. And I first began playing music at the 101 Ranch with Jimmy Palau. That's all right, Jimmy Palau.

Yeah, let me put something on here first. We want to get all our voices down. We want to put the date on for one thing too. Let's see, the day is July, huh? Yeah, the first of July, 1960. Mm-hmm. And this is in New Orleans.
